name: Rooted in STEM
org: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
what_you_do: A Saturday program (4 Saturdays each fall and spring, 10 am to 1 pm) with lab tours, demos, mentors and career talks, plus summer camps and research assistantships. It runs through the fall of 12th grade.
who_can_apply: Current 10th graders from groups that are not well represented in STEM. You should plan to go to a four year college. You must commit to one Saturday a month through December of 12th grade.
pay_detail: Free; lunch and a gift included. No stipend. Students who attend through fall of 12th grade and are admitted to the College of Science and Engineering can get a $40,000 scholarship ($10,000 a year for 4 years, from 3M).
duration: January of 10th grade to December of 12th grade
deadline_text: Applications open in early November and close in early December. The page lists a Dec 1 deadline and Dec 19 decisions but the years on the page look mixed up, so check the page for the current cycle.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It needs a note from a STEM teacher or counselor, personal essays, your GPA and a list of your courses.
notes: You must get yourself to the program. Money for rides is available if you ask. Only 10th graders are accepted from 2025 on.
